title: Personal watercraft (PWC) licence
summary: This page provides information on how to apply for, renew, replace, or manage a personal watercraft (PWC) driving licence in New South Wales.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a PWC driving licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a personal watercraft (PWC) driving licence using the dedicated application page.

faqs.q: What do I need to do if I want to renew or restore my PWC licence?
faqs.a: You can renew or restore your personal watercraft (PWC) driving licence through the official transaction page.

faqs.q: How can I change my PWC licence conditions or downgrade it?
faqs.a: You can change the conditions for your PWC licence or downgrade from a PWC licence to a general boat licence.
